answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 30401 Country: India Title: Beard is sunnat or wazib in hanafi? Question: Beard is sunnat or wazib in hanafi? Answer ID: 30401 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 383/283/L=1432) It is wajib. The holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) has emphatically ordered us to grow beard. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
